name: Zac
notes: Opens with Let's Bounce! (R) at t=0, assumed off cooldown; it bounces once after its 0.3s cast then 3 more times, 1s apart, and all four bounces are assumed to land on the stationary, adjacent dummy — bounces 2-4 at the 50% 'subsequent bounce' damage per Riot's DamageReductionBounce.

While Let's Bounce! is resolving (its interaction table marks Q and E as disabled and basic attacks as unusable, with W still usable), the driver holds Zac's next attack and blocks Q/E casts until the final bounce lands; W is still woven in during this window.

Elastic Slingshot is modeled as an immediate press-and-instant-recast with no held channel: charging only extends range, which never matters against an already-adjacent, stationary dummy, so its cooldown (using the wiki's 21-9s value; see 'assumed' for the bin's 22-10s discrepancy) starts right on this instant recast.

Stretching Strikes' tether always finds the dummy as its only target, so per the wiki's 'same target dealt both hits' ruling both instances of its damage land on the dummy: the initial cast, then the empowered attack (0.25s cast) that replaces Zac's next basic attack. The empowered attack deals no basic-attack damage, cannot critically strike, and Q's cooldown (post-effect) starts only once it lands.

Unstable Matter has no cast time and is woven on cooldown throughout the fight, including during Let's Bounce!; its target-max-health-ratio damage is not capped, since the wiki's 200 cap only applies to minions/monsters, not champions (or this dummy).

Cell Division's chunk-drop/pickup loop is approximated as uncontestable and instantaneous: every ability hit (Q once per cast, W once per cast, E once per cast, and each Let's Bounce! bounce) is assumed to immediately shed a chunk that Zac instantly collects, shaving 1 second off Unstable Matter's current cooldown per chunk, per the wiki's stated default ('uncontestable') chunk behaviour.

Q/W/E's health costs are paid from current health (as the wiki's costtype states) and so asymptotically never fully drain Zac; they are otherwise not modeled since they never block a cast within the fight window.
Cell Division's resurrection, its chunk self-heal, and the passive's size changes are purely defensive/cosmetic and add no damage dealt, so they are not modeled here.

assumed.why: the wiki lists 21-9s while the bin lists 22-10s at every rank; the dossier judged the wiki value authoritative, so it is used here

Elastic Slingshot's charge (0.9-1.3s ChannelTime by rank, extending range) is assumed held for 0 seconds and recast immediately, since extra range gives no benefit against an already-in-range stationary dummy
